chunks: And from him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil, from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of them (peace be upon them both), who said:
"There is no option (of return) except upon purity, from non-consummation, with witnesses."

key_terms.خِيَار: Option/Right of choice (specifically in the context of returning a divorced wife)

ai.seo_question: What are the conditions for a valid right of option (khayr) in Shia Islamic divorce law?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the specific conditions for the right of option (*khayr*) in divorce, requiring the wife to be in a state of purity (*tuhr*) and not yet consummated with the husband, a ruling verified by witnesses. In Shia jurisprudence, this ensures the wife can exercise her choice before the marital bond is fully sealed through intimacy, preventing ambiguity in the status of the marriage.
